title: 第15章 但求一败第16章 是直觉
lines: 第15章但求一败
可这比赛是中考过后，连报名时间都没开始，现在根本参加不了。
其余大大小小的对战训练场所也都有限制。
像地下御兽黑赛专门供人赌博取乐的倒没有要求御兽师到达什么等级。
这种性质的比赛门槛低，e级御兽师就可以参加，只是参加这种地下赛的都是些三教九流。
赛前要签协议，宠兽对战中生死不论。
正规的比赛一方宠兽没有战斗能力了会有裁判来及时终止比赛，还有专门的医疗队在后方为宠兽进行治疗。
地下御兽黑赛不是，这种比赛只有等一方御兽师自动认输才算完事。
来这比赛的都是些狠人跟赌徒。
有些是因为宠兽没什么潜力了不在意宠兽的死活，有些是为了捞快钱，还有些纯粹就是为了追求这种暴力刺激的快感。
总之不是乔桑这样的初中生该来的地方。
火牙狗还太小，乔桑不准备一下子给它见识这么残酷的比赛。
按乔桑原先的想法，等中考结束先训练火牙狗的速度跟体力，基础训练好了再练习对绝招的控制力。
金手指能让火牙狗短时间内通过战斗获得点数加成，可要是身体素质跟不上，控制不了自身的能量就发挥不了同等级宠兽该有的战斗力。
现在要短时间内进步，就不能这么慢慢来。
只有对战能快速增强火牙狗的战斗力。
乔桑想要的是点到为止的对战，可不是死斗。
除了正式御兽比赛和地下御兽黑赛，各个地区还有训练馆，俱乐部，交流会这样的场所能进行宠兽对战。
训练馆半年一招，专门帮御兽师训练宠兽指定的绝招，现在不是报名时间进不去。
俱乐部单纯要钱，乔桑没钱。
交流会去的都是在正式比赛中露过脸受人邀请发了邀请函才能去的。
大多人平时宠兽对战会跟周围的朋友切磋一番，可乔桑认识的人脑域都还没觉醒更别说宠兽对战了。
这么一总结下来，整个杭港市竟然没有让火牙狗好好战斗的地方。
难不成街上随便拉一个人说我要跟你进行宠兽对战？
万一拉到d级以上的御兽师怎么死的都不知道。
乔桑在街道来回踱步，认真思考着。
五分钟后，她抱着火牙狗往家的方向走去。
乔桑回到家，脱下学校的校服换了件日常的衣服，随后到房间在纸上写了几个字撕下来，再拿了卷胶带放进口袋。
随后背起书包出门。
杭港第三十七御兽高中旁，南河公园。
“同学，要不要来点烧烤。”摆着摊的阿姨在公园口招呼着。
乔桑看了看时间，16点27分，离第三十七御兽高中放学还有一个小时左右。
“来10串羊肉吧。”乔桑来到烧烤摊旁。
“要辣吗？”阿姨见来了生意，咧着嘴询问道。
“不要。”乔桑摇摇头。
“你是这个学校的吗？我怎么好像都没见过你。”阿姨忙活着手上的动作还不忘聊着天。
“不是，我是来等人的。”乔桑回答道。
“我说呢，这么好看的女生我要是见过肯定不会忘的。”阿姨笑道。
乔桑礼貌性笑了笑。
她从小到大经常被人夸，小时候还会不好意思，长大就麻木了，
五分钟后，乔桑接过羊肉串，拿了串给快要流口水的火牙狗。
火牙狗欢快地叫了一声，两只爪子接过后低头就吃了起来。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Just seek defeat
But this competition is after the high school entrance examination, and the registration time has not even started. Now I can't participate at all.
Other large and small combat training venues also have restrictions.
For example, the underground beast-taming black games are designed for people to gamble and have fun, but there is no requirement for the beast-taming master to reach any level.
The threshold for competitions of this nature is low, and only E-level beast masters can participate. However, only those who participate in this kind of underground competitions are from different religions.
An agreement must be signed before the game, and the pets will not care whether they live or die in the battle.
In a regular match, if one side's pet becomes incapable of fighting, a referee will promptly terminate the game, and a specialized medical team will treat the pet at the rear.
This is not the case with the underground beast control black competition. This kind of competition can only be completed when one of the beast control masters voluntarily admits defeat.
The people who come to this competition are ruthless people and gamblers.
Some do it because they don't care about their life and death because they have little potential, some do it to make quick money, and some do it purely to pursue the thrill of violence.
In short, this is not the place where a junior high school student like Qiao Sang should come.
The fire-toothed dog was still too young, and Qiao Sang was not prepared to let it experience such a cruel competition all at once.
According to Qiao Sang's original idea, he would first train the speed and physical strength of the Fire Tooth Dog after the high school entrance examination. After basic training, he would then practice the control of his special moves.
The golden finger allows the Fire Fang Dog to gain points bonus through combat in a short period of time, but if its physical fitness cannot keep up and it cannot control its own energy, it will not be able to exert the combat effectiveness that a pet of the same level should have.
Now if we want to make progress in a short period of time, we can't take it so slowly.
Only fighting can quickly enhance the combat effectiveness of the Fire Tooth Dog.
What Qiao Sang wanted was a fight to the end, not a fight to the death.
In addition to official beast control competitions and underground beast control black competitions, various regions also have training halls, clubs, exchange meetings and other places where pet beast battles can be held.
The training hall offers a move every half a year, specifically to help beast masters train pet beasts with designated tricks. Now is the time to sign up, so you can’t get in.
The club simply wants money, and Qiao Sang has no money.
Those who go to the exchange meeting can only go after they have shown their faces in official competitions and been invited by others and sent invitation letters.
Most people usually compete with friends around them when it comes to pet beast battles, but the people Qiao Sang knows have not yet awakened their brains, let alone pet beast battles.
To sum up, there is no place in Hanggang City for the Fire Tooth Dog to fight well.
Could it be possible that a random person on the street would pull up and say, "I want to have a pet battle with you?"
I don’t know how the beast master who was pulled above level D died.
Qiao Sang paced back and forth on the street, thinking seriously.
Five minutes later, she hugged the fire-toothed dog and walked towards home.
Qiao Sang returned home, took off his school uniform and changed into some daily clothes. Then he went to his room, wrote a few words on a piece of paper, tore it off, then took a roll of tape and put it in his pocket.
Then he picked up his schoolbag and went out.
…
Next to Hanggang No. 37 Royal Beast High School, Nanhe Park.
"Classmate, would you like some barbecue?" the aunt who set up a stall greeted at the entrance of the park.
Qiao Sang looked at the time. It was 16:27, about an hour before the end of school at the 37th Beast Control High School.
"Let's have 10 skewers of mutton." Qiao Sang came to the barbecue stall.
"Do you want it spicy?" Auntie asked with a grin on her face when she saw the business.
"No." Qiao Sang shook his head.
"Are you from this school? I never seem to have seen you before." The aunt was busy with her hands and did not forget to chat.
"No, I'm here to wait for someone." Qiao Sang replied.
"Let me tell you, if I see such a beautiful girl, I will definitely never forget it." Auntie said with a smile.
Qiao Sang smiled politely.
She was often praised by others since she was a child. She was embarrassed when she was a child, but became numb when she grew up.
Five minutes later, Qiao Sang took the mutton skewers and gave them to the fire-toothed dog who was about to drool.
"Tooth!"
The Fire Tooth Dog barked happily, took it with his two paws, lowered his head and started eating.
